title: Hollow round-to-rectangular adapter
purpose: Measure topology-sensitive construction across dissimilar profiles while preserving a continuous hollow passage.
complexityRationale: Dissimilar loft profiles, wall offset behavior, and two open ends create topology and validity risks absent from prismatic parts.

turns.text: Build a 50 mm long hollow adapter from a 40 mm outside-diameter round inlet to a 50 by 30 mm rectangular outlet. Keep a 3 mm nominal wall and leave both ends open.

requirements.description: The adapter spans a 50 by 30 by 50 mm outer envelope within tolerance.
The nominal wall thickness is 3 mm and both terminal profiles remain open.
The body forms one coherent round-to-rectangular transition without unintended pinches or twists.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: A capped, invalid, self-intersecting, or pinched loft cannot satisfy the adapter request.

sourceSafety.notes: Synthetic transition geometry with no user-derived design evidence.
